overview_description.description:
Merlin investor is a Fintech company operating in MENA, EMEA, and NAFTA, on mission to democratize financial inclusion and investment planning towards conscious investing, while helping financial institutions to supercharge their investment platforms to win over the new generation of retail investors.

The Merlin Platform serves as an educational, strategizing, and tracking tool tailored for retail investment planning and risks management. It is the perfect companion to any trading platform, It can be used with any type of asset, and It is designed to accommodate all types of investors, irrespective of their financial knowledge or investing experience. 
 
The product is offered directly to the final consumers through a subscription model (B2C SaaS), as well as It is white labelled to Financial Institutions to be embedded into their investment platforms (B2B2C BaaS).

Merli Investor is the new realm for investment planning and portfolio management, enhancing conscious investing and catering to any type of investor.
